name: one-table
description: Touch-first, bilingual menu planning for a single dinner or gathering. The product combines a curated local recipe catalogue, deterministic safety and feasibility rules, and AI-assisted menu composition and explanation.

scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply menu-planning-db --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply menu-planning-db --remote --env production
scripts.recipes:import:local: npm run recipes:generate-sql && wrangler d1 execute menu-planning-db --local --file .generated/launch-recipes.sql
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.prebuild: npm run clean:icloud && npm run recipes:emit && npm run tenant:emit
scripts.deploy:demo: TENANT=sample-centre opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env demo
scripts.deploy:demo-grocer: TENANT=sample-grocer opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env demo-grocer
scripts.deploy:demo-pavilion: TENANT=market-pavilion opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env demo-pavilion
